description: This file contains unit tests for the 'MongoQueryBuilder' class, specifically testing its limited query building capability in the context of a MongoDB integration. It verifies correct handling of criteria, sorting options, limits, and skip parameters, along with validation checks for invalid inputs.

classes.name: MongoQueryBuilderLimitedTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the limited query-building functionality of MongoQueryBuilder, validating parameters such as criteria, sorting, limit, and skip, and ensuring proper exception handling for invalid inputs.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading configuration and creating a DefaultLimitsConfig instance.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializing the MongoQueryBuilder with the appropriate configuration limits.

methods.name: createWithNullCriteria
methods.description: Tests that passing null as criteria to the limited constructor throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildWithCriteriaOnly
methods.description: Verifies that the query built contains the provided criteria.

methods.name: buildWithSort
methods.description: Tests that specifying sort options correctly reflects in the built query.

methods.name: appendDefaultSortOption
methods.description: Checks that a default sort option is appended if not specified.

methods.name: buildWithLimit
methods.description: Verifies that setting a limit on the query respects the maximum configured limit.

methods.name: buildWithSkip
methods.description: Verifies that setting a skip value in the query is correctly reflected.

methods.name: buildWithLimitGreaterThanMaxValue
methods.description: Ensures that setting a limit higher than the maximum allowed results in an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: buildWithLimitLessThanZero
methods.description: Ensures that setting a negative limit throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: buildWithSkipLessThanZero
methods.description: Ensures that setting a negative skip value throws an IllegalArgumentException.
